description: Workforce Orchestration for Enterprise. Connecting tasks to internal employees, contingent talent and AI Agents.
problem_statement: Skill shortages is costing Enterprise CIO's $5.5 trillion. We fill skill shortages through orchestrating internal employees, contingent workers and AI Agents.

team.justification: The founding team has strong domain expertise and a proven track record in digital transformation. The CEO and CTO have a long-standing relationship and complementary skills, which enhances their execution capability.

company_assessment.business_model_strength: Gigged.AI operates a dual revenue model with a marketplace take rate and a SaaS subscription, providing diversified income streams and scalability.
company_assessment.market_positioning: The company uniquely targets CIOs and CTOs, addressing a critical pain point of skill shortages with a comprehensive solution beyond internal mobility.
company_assessment.execution_capability: Demonstrated ability to pivot from SME to enterprise focus, indicating strategic agility and execution strength.
company_assessment.strategic_vision: The leadership has a clear vision of integrating AI agents with human talent to address skill shortages, aligning with market trends.
